reason_for_interrupt: The bounded full-stack replay spent six local-model calls inspecting request-relevant implementation and test context, then emitted a read after the controller had transitioned to plan-only. The resulting recovery generation produced no auditable action before interruption. Continuing could not distinguish model competence from the discovered harness information-flow defect.

wall.root_cause: Successful read content was serialized before the controller state in a lexically sorted TOOL_RESULT object and then truncated at the tool-result character ceiling. Large reads could therefore hide state.required_next_phase and the legal action set from the local model.

repair.successor: Worker-v4 development with phase-first tool-result protocol
